scope: Matched full-workload CPU diagnostic of explicit one-tick and sixty-tick RPC stepping; no production optimization in this checkpoint.

sdk_lineage.policy: CoreCLR unifies Poima SDK to the bridge assembly; differing original169 SDK remains pinned, and its IL on the selected SDK has separate185 native qualification.

verified.epoch_policy: Original checkpoints remain unmodified. Before the counterpart first tick, complete expected payloads retain every source field except the two source-derived ObservedEpochHigh/ObservedEpochLow values set from that destination host epoch, observed at tick zero. Every other difference fails.

measurements.normalization: Sum of inclusive native region durations divided by measured committed ticks; RPC wall brackets retained separately. Regions overlap; worker durations may overlap.
measurements.percentiles: Nearest-rank within each trial, per region invocation; they are not per-frame or per-tick latency percentiles.

export_reconstruction.derived_method: round(original_export_dur_us*1000), validated against every original CPU summary statistic; original responses untouched

interpretation.checkpoint_scope_limit: Excludes preceding checkpoint_structure and previous-motion preparation, and later component begin_batch.
interpretation.next_source_supported_candidate: Repeated exact authored-state comparison in runtime_summary during runtime.inspect; requires complete publication invalidation rather than revision-only caching.

actual_case.scope: Pinned inputs, original raw RPC joins, complete checkpoints and prospective forecasts, source closure and actual process ownership.

profile.scope: Original export events, all CPU/counter summary statistics, sessions, ticks, frequencies and raw RPC associations.

failed_file_only_attempts.outcome: Plan written, then relative path rejected by terminal metadata pinning; no native actor.
failed_file_only_attempts.successor: Explicit absolute output; unchanged preparation source.

failed_file_only_attempts.outcome: Expected stderr filename used wrong suffix; no native actor.
failed_file_only_attempts.successor: Only retained filename association corrected; original case unchanged.

failed_file_only_attempts.outcome: Python SyntaxError before audit body; no native actor.

limits: Short CPU diagnostic on one laptop with profiling; not FPS, interactive player throughput or input latency.
Grouping changes guard/transport cadence and batch-boundary work together; no isolated checkpoint-only speedup or causal decomposition.
Native inclusive regions overlap; do not sum them or add external RPC walltime.
Three alternating pairs do not isolate caches, scheduling, thermal state, JIT or ordinary GC.
No allocation or memory-growth causality, rendered observer-overhead, thirty-minute reliability, physical input, clean-install or Alpha closure.
Exact reproduction requires retained world/assets, original compiled gameplay/SDK closure, selected bridge/SDK closure, hostfxr and original traces; not a clean-checkout benchmark.
Original game and bridge SDK hashes differ; both remain pinned, with separately qualified actual host consumption. Equal ABI versions alone do not prove compatibility.
